description: This file contains unit tests for currency utility functions related to converting USD to credits, formatting credits, and rendering credits with USD. It tests the behavior of functions exported from the './currency' module.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts USD amount to credits based on configured rate.

methods.name: formatCredits
methods.description: Formats the credits number into a human-readable string with 'credits' suffix.

methods.name: renderCreditsWithUsd
methods.description: Renders credits amount with USD in parenthesis.
